section_summary.extract_value: This section presents an abstract of a study validating the Dutch translation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) with 310 female university students from the Netherlands (Mage = 21.31). The study assessed construct validity through measures of appearance satisfaction, functionality satisfaction, self-objectification, self-esteem, and optimistic life orientation, revealing a one-dimensional factor structure and good internal consistency (α = .90). The findings indicate that lower body mass indices were associated with higher BAS-2 scores, supporting the cross-cultural equivalence of the BAS-2.
